answer.rationale: Verify the incumbent-renegotiation and multi-year pricing records before negotiating. With the contract expiring in 14 days and production at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, negotiation offers the best chance to reduce total cost while preserving continuity and avoiding migration or supply disruption. A benchmarked renewal could combine price concessions, improved payment terms, and volume pricing, while the 18% savings target remains uncertain rather than assumed.
